title: Motion on notice for bail (High Court)
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Criminal Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every statutory provision cited.

parts.why: Names the court, the judicial division and where it sits. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Names the court, the judicial division and where it sits. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
CHARGE NO: {{chargeNumber}}
BETWEEN:
{{complainant}} .................... COMPLAINANT/RESPONDENT
AND
{{defendant}} .................... DEFENDANT/APPLICANT
parts.why: The charge number and the parties exactly as on the charge. Use 'Defendant', not 'Accused', and the defendant's full name (with any alias given). In Lagos the State is 'The State of Lagos'; in the FCT the Commissioner of Police or the Federal Republic of Nigeria, as on the charge. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: MOTION ON NOTICE BROUGHT PURSUANT TO SECTION 35 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF THE FEDERAL REPUBLIC OF NIGERIA 1999 (AS AMENDED), {{bailProvision}} AND UNDER THE INHERENT JURISDICTION OF THIS HONOURABLE COURT
parts.why: The title and the law the motion is brought under. An application for bail at the Court of Appeal takes the same form. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
TAKE NOTICE that this Honourable Court will be moved on the ............ day of ............ 20..... at the hour of 9 o'clock in the forenoon or so soon thereafter as counsel to the Defendant/Applicant may be heard, praying the Court for the following reliefs:
#. AN ORDER of this Honourable Court admitting the Defendant/Applicant to bail pending trial.
#. AND FOR SUCH FURTHER ORDER OR ORDERS as this Honourable Court may deem fit to make in the circumstances.
parts.why: The notice of the hearing and the reliefs sought. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Left for the date of filing. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Counsel signs the process; the space is left for the signature.
Counsel's name, chambers, address for service, email and phone number. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Names who is to be served: the prosecuting authority, for example the Attorney-General of Lagos State, Ministry of Justice. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Judicial division
fields.question: Which judicial division is the charge in? For example: Ikeja.

fields.label: Charge number
fields.question: The charge number, if known. Leave it empty to show a blank for it.

fields.label: Complainant
fields.question: Who is the complainant on the charge? For example: The State of Lagos.

fields.label: Defendant
fields.question: The defendant's full name, as on the charge.

fields.label: Statutory provision for bail
fields.question: Which provision of the Administration of Criminal Justice Law or Act do you bring the application under? Check it in the library.
fields.placeholder: PROVISION OF THE ACJL OR ACJA

fields.label: Prosecuting authority and address
fields.question: Who prosecutes, and where are they served? For example: Attorney-General of Lagos State, Ministry of Justice, Alausa, Ikeja.

fields.label: Counsel's name
fields.question: Who is the legal practitioner signing this process?

fields.label: Counsel's chambers
fields.question: Which law firm or chambers is counsel in?

fields.label: Counsel's address for service and contacts
fields.question: Counsel's address for service, email and phone number.
